summary: Iteration 3 verified half-hour booking slots and the new Stripe-subscription flow end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_billing_stripe.py — /api/billing/status shape, auth-guards on /billing/status + /billing/checkout, POST /api/billing/checkout returns a Stripe hosted checkout URL (cs_... session_id, url containing checkout.stripe.com) via the Emergent proxy base, GET /api/billing/verify with an unpaid session keeps status in trial/trialing (does not escalate to active), /api/billing/verify requires session_id (422), and POST /api/stripe/webhook (a) accepts unsigned events in preview, (b) is idempotent via stripe_events collection (duplicate=true on replay), (c) activates the user on customer.subscription.updated via metadata.user_id, and (d) returns 400 on malformed body. Frontend web (1280x900): login works, /booking/new now exposes every half-hour slot 08:00→18:30 (all 22 testIDs bk-time-HH:MM present, zero missing); /paywall ‘Start 14-day free trial’ button calls /api/billing/checkout (200) and the paywall client code calls window.location.assign with the Stripe URL (confirmed via backend test; frontend-side URL capture via assign-override intermittent but call reached backend); /billing/success route exists, fires /api/billing/verify, and renders a graceful ‘Almost there / HTTP 502 / Try again’ state when the session_id is invalid (expected); /billing/cancelled route exists and shows the ‘Checkout cancelled’ copy with cancelled-back + cancelled-skip buttons; More tab shows the billing-card driven by /api/billing/status. Deprecated packages detected: none. One real bug surfaced on the More tab billing card — see rca_of_issue.

critical.issue: trial_days_left returns 0 and entitled=false for a freshly-registered user whose trial has 14 days left. _subscription_summary parses trial_ends_at as a NAIVE datetime (Mongo drops tzinfo on storage) and then subtracts now_utc() which is tz-aware; this raises TypeError and is swallowed by the broad except → days_left defaults to 0, entitled becomes False, and the UI renders ‘Trial ended / Subscribe’ instead of ‘14 days of trial left / Upgrade’. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:904-922.

minor.issue: Not exercised in preview per main-agent note. Will 400 (‘No active subscription’) for users without stripe_customer_id and may 502 if the Emergent proxy doesn’t route billing_portal.Session.create. Fine for now.

ui_bugs.issue: Shows ‘Trial ended / Subscribe’ for the demo user even though the account is 0 days old — downstream of the backend tz bug above. Once backend returns correct trial_days_left, the card will self-correct to the intended ‘Upgrade’ copy.

action_items: FIX /app/backend/server.py:904-922 _subscription_summary — make trial_ends_at parsing tz-aware. E.g. after datetime.fromisoformat(...) do `if end.tzinfo is None: end = end.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` before the subtraction. Also consider initialising the AsyncIOMotorClient with tz_aware=True so Mongo-stored datetimes come back as aware across the whole codebase.

After the fix, verify that GET /api/billing/status for demo@petadmin.app returns trial_days_left ≈ 14 (depending on seed timing) and entitled=true, and that the More tab billing-card renders ‘<N> days of trial left / Upgrade’ instead of ‘Trial ended / Subscribe’.
(optional) Add a Pydantic model (SessionIn) for /billing/verify so missing session_id returns 422 with a clean message (already does — just cleaner contract).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:904-922 broad `except Exception: days_left = 0` masked the real tz subtraction error — prefer explicit (TypeError, ValueError) and log the exception so bugs like this surface in logs.

server.py:51 AsyncIOMotorClient should be created with `tz_aware=True` so BSON datetimes round-trip as timezone-aware. This is the systemic cause of the trial calc bug and will keep biting any other time-math code.

server.py:960 stripe.checkout.Session.create is passed `customer_email` but no idempotency_key — multiple rapid taps of ‘Start trial’ would create multiple Stripe sessions / customers. Low risk but worth an idempotency key per user+day.
paywall.tsx:34 origin is read from window.location.origin on web but will be '' on native — fine today (web-only paywall), but note it before shipping native.

rca_of_issue: BUG: trial_days_left always 0 → ‘Trial ended’ card for brand-new users. REPRO: register (or use demo@) → GET /api/billing/status → see trial_days_left=0 even though trial_ends_at is 14 days in the future. ROOT CAUSE: AsyncIOMotorClient is created without tz_aware=True, so trial_ends_at stored as a tz-aware datetime comes back NAIVE. _subscription_summary converts it to ISO (still naive, no offset) and then datetime.fromisoformat() returns a naive datetime. The subtraction `end - now_utc()` raises `TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes`, which the broad except catches and defaults days_left=0; entitled then collapses to False. MITIGATION (any one): (a) in _subscription_summary, after fromisoformat, `if end.tzinfo is None: end = end.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)`; (b) initialise the Mongo client with tz_aware=True; (c) store trial_ends_at as an ISO string in Mongo. Option (a)+(b) together is safest.
